import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0180 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {A B C : Set α} (hA : fintype A) (hB : fintype B) : 
  f '' (A ∪ B) ⊆ f '' A ∪ f '' B := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0180 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {A B C : Set α} (hA : fintype A) (hB : fintype B) : 
  f '' (A ∪ B) ⊆ f '' A ∪ f '' B := by
  ext y
  have : ∃ x, x ∈ A ∪ B ∧ f x = y := by
    use if y ∈ f '' A then classical.some this else classical.some (mem_of_mem_image_of_mem B (mem_of_mem_image_of_mem A this))
  obtain ⟨x, hxA_or_hxB, hx_fy⟩ := this
  have hxA_or_hxB : x ∈ A ∨ x ∈ B := by
    cases hxA_or_hxB with hxA hxB
    · exact hxA
    · exact hxB
  have : y ∈ f '' A ∨ y ∈ f '' B := by
    cases hxA_or_hxB with hxA hxB
    · exact mem_image_of_mem hxA hx_fy
    · exact mem_image_of_mem hxB hx_fy
  exact this
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0180 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0180 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0180

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0180
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0180
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
